CustomField.description: Resumable batch cursor (AXF-118): semicolon-separated `SOURCE:lastId` entries (FTX/BAT/CCT), written only after the artifact content for that chunk is durably persisted. A source with no entry has not been reached yet (or has no rows for the scope); resuming re-queries each source strictly after its last recorded id, so a retry after a chunk failure never re-emits or loses a row.
CustomField.label: Cursor
